name: Amayakashite yo Kareshi-kun!
original_name: 甘やかしてよ彼氏くんっ！
source: In the fall of your first year of working life, the protagonist is busy working overtime. One day, when you come home late at night as usual, you see your long-distance boyfriend in front of your door.
translation: 工作生活第一年的秋天，主角忙着加班。有一天，当你像往常一样深夜回到家时，你看到远方的男朋友在你家门口。
